ops.text: Riya's son Leo was born July 17, 2019 (use for forms). In fall 2025 he is in grade 2 at Morse Street Public School; his teacher is Ms. Alvarez (Room 104).
Contact Ms. Alvarez (Leo's grade 2 teacher at Morse Street PS) through the school's Edsby app, not by email.
School pickup swap (from Sept 2025): Riya picks up Leo and Jun (Hannah Cho's son) on Wednesdays at about 15:20; Hannah does Fridays.
Meeting rule for Riya: do not book anything before 9:30 or after 16:30 (it used to be 17:00), and nothing after 15:00 on Fridays because of school pickup.

Spanish with Carlos Méndez: since Sept 2025 the lesson is every Thursday 20:00 (8:00 pm) on Zoom, 60 minutes, with a homework review at 19:30 (calendar series moved from Tuesdays, starting 18 Sep 2025).
Shopping preference: Riya prefers Canadian retailers (MEC, Indigo, Simons) and skips Amazon whenever a local option ships within a week.
Sensitive topic: Riya and Sam had a very difficult time trying for a second child in 2024. Do not bring it up unless Riya does.
Riya has a beagle named Biscuit who howls (his 'siren solo').
Mei (Kabir's partner and a houseguest) is lactose intolerant and a big fan of Riya's chana masala. Cook dairy-free for her (no ghee, yogurt, cream; coconut raita, oil naan).

Plan: Kabir and Mei stay with Riya the second weekend of November 2025 (Nov 8-9); Riya will host a proper dinner on Saturday Nov 8 built around chana masala. Menu in note 'Nov dinner - Kabir & Mei': jeera rice, oil naan, aloo gobi, kachumber, coconut raita, coconut milk kheer made a day ahead.
Morse Street PS Picture Day is Thursday 9 October 2025 (online ordering opens Mon 6 Oct); it had no calendar entry yet.

Plan: street yard sale on Sat 4 Oct 2025, 9:00-13:00 (rain date Sun 5 Oct); tables on own driveways, no early birds before 9. The City bans yard-sale signs on poles; use a sandwich board on the boulevard.
Riya's furnace uses 16x25x1 MERV 11 filters, bought as a 4-pack from Home Depot (Leslie St store).

Riya's mother Anjali (68) lives alone in Mumbai (Bandra area) since Riya's father died; her flat has stairs. Riya worries about her; ideas discussed: a neighbour or relative nearby with a spare key, a daily 'good morning' WhatsApp signal, medical info written down, stair rails and lighting.
When Riya is anxious or worried, she is calmed by talking through concrete practical plans, not by reassurance like 'it'll be fine'.
Riya asked for shorter answers when she reads late at night in bed (she found replies too wordy).
Leo has swim lessons every Tuesday at 17:30-18:15 at the Pam McConnell Aquatic Centre (640 Dundas St E, Regent Park), starting 30 Sep 2025.
Open to-do for Riya: get passport photos for Leo.
Northline Renovations (contact: Nate) is doing renovation work at Riya's home (cabinets). Progress invoice #NR-2207 ($6,500) was due Fri 3 Oct 2025.

Riya works at Lumen Pay on payouts (planning Q4 2025: reconciliation CSV export v2, payout status webhooks, instant payout fee experiment; ~2.5 engineers; bank partner API migration risk in November). Colleagues include Aisha Rahman, Diego, Wen, Olivia and manager-level contact Tom.
Sam (Sam Okafor) is Riya's partner; they live together with Leo.
When writing to or for Tom, give one recommendation plus one alternative, not an open-ended list of options (Tom responds much better).
Spanish rule: if a lesson with Carlos clashes with work, message Carlos at least 24 hours ahead to move it; he charges for later cancellations.
Leo takes piano with Mrs. Greene every Monday 16:30-17:15 at her home on Pape Avenue (from Mon 6 Oct 2025).
Recurring reminder: replace the 16x25x1 furnace filter every 3 months (first on Sat 4 Jan 2026, then 4 Apr, 4 Jul 2026). Spare filters are on the laundry room shelf.

Travel preference: for family trips to Ottawa Riya always prefers driving the Mazda over the train, leaving early Friday to beat 401 traffic, with a stop at the Big Apple in Colborne (Leo treats it as a rule). Use for Christmas planning. Toronto (Leslieville) to Ottawa Glebe is about 452 km, 4 h 35 min without traffic.
Sam gets migraines from strong fragrances, so Riya's home has no scented candles or air fresheners; avoid scented gifts (candles, soaps, perfume) for the household.

To do before the cold: book the snow tire swap for the Mazda (options found: Leslieville Auto Service Fri 24 Oct 8:30 $70; Kal Tire Eastern Ave Sat 25 Oct 9:00 or 11:30 $79.95; Canadian Tire Leslie St Wed 22 Oct 18:00 $89.99); none booked yet as of 11 Oct 2025. Appointments fill up in late October.
Leo's grade 2 class goes on a Toronto Zoo field trip Wed 22 Oct 2025; permission form and $18 due Fri 17 Oct via School Cash Online. Volunteers needed (2 parents per class).
Plan: Northline Renovations cabinet delivery Thu 16 Oct 2025, 8:00-10:00; someone must be home to let the crew in.
Grace and Daniel hosted Riya's family for Thanksgiving 2025 in Ottawa (Glebe area); Grace bakes (four pies), Daniel is a civil engineer.
As of Tue 14 Oct 2025 Riya had not reached her mother Anjali since the weekend (no answer to calls or texts) and was worried; she planned to try Anjali's cousin. Anjali's phone often dies.
Jun Cho is Leo's best friend and Hannah Cho's son; Leo and Jun walk to Morse Street PS together most mornings.
Writing style: Riya dislikes salesy, press-release hype (exclamation marks, 'game-changing', DM pitches). Prefers calm, concrete wording with one specific change and real names credited.

Class snack: it is Leo's turn to bring the class snack to Ms. Alvarez's grade 2 class on Fri 17 Oct 2025 (22 students; label everything with ingredients). Ordered PC Express order PCX-77310452 at Real Canadian Superstore, 17 Leslie St, pickup Thu 16 Oct 17:30-18:00, $40.47.
